sentences.japanese: いままで試してきた他の政治形態を除いて考えると、民主主義とは最低の政治形態だ。
sentences.english: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.

sentences.japanese: 君はもっと自己主張を試みたほうがよい。
sentences.english: You'd better try to assert yourself more.

sentences.japanese: 靴を買う前には、試しに履いてみなければならない。
sentences.english: Before buying shoes, you should try them on.

sentences.japanese: 我々の試みは、結局失敗した。
sentences.english: Our attempt has proved to be a failure.
